thread:
mel_sales: Hey team — Vega Systems (healthcare) needs a small dedicated POC for on-call summarization. They want us-west1, H100-80GB, start with 2 GPUs, burst to 6. They need VPC peering + B2B VPN + customer-managed KMS. Can infra estimate and any compliance blockers?

raj_se: couple clarifying q's: model size? quant? seq len and concurrency?

mel_sales: they indicated 70B, seq len 2048 for long context, concurrency low ~8 sessions at 0.2 req/s. No quantization, must be fp16. Also they want logs forwarded to their SIEM.

frank_infra: 70B + 2048 context is heavy. 2 H100s will likely be insufficient for memory; we'd recommend minimum 4 H100s or A100-80GB nodes. Latency target?

mel_sales: target p95 < 300ms but SLAs not firm for POC. They mainly want to validate functional accuracy and privacy features.

raj_se: SIEM forwarding + customer KMS + VPN raises compliance bar. We'll need legal sign-off and SOC review; estimate extra 5-7 days for SOC and network approvals.

infra-bot: Provisioning ticket #PROV-9155 created. status: pending-customer-approval. assignee: frank_infra.

frank_infra: I'll draft a config. Also note: long ctx=2048 will increase GPU memory and KV cache requirements; add "cache_enabled": true and "kv_backend": "ephemeral" if they don't need persistence.

mel_sales: great. can we provide a temporary hosted key for fallback? they want to test hosted fallback while VPN setup completes.

frank_infra: yes, we can issue a hosted scoped key TTL 10 days, but security needs the allowed CIDR list. Add to ticket. Also flagging potential cost uplift due to long context and no quant.

raj_se: pricing: offer 30-day POC with custom pricing; will follow up via DM. Also will send security questionnaire template.

mel_sales: I'll get CIDR + contact + SIEM destination. thanks team!
